examples.phrase: yielding a pre-registered NO-GO verdict because the difference is below 1 dB and within limiter compression and run-to-run variation
examples.problem: The claim gives the wrong reason for the verdict, an unsupported causal link. Under the frozen rule, NO-GO is returned only when LST-BTH is not higher on every placement-ok trip. A difference under 1 dB with every trip positive gives WEAK, not NO-GO. 23 Oct alone shows this: +0.60 dB, positive on 5/5 trips, verdict WEAK.
